notes: Regression evals derived from three manual test cycles. Fixtures live in evals/fixtures/ and carry intentional, planted drift; do not clean them. The skill is disable-model-invocation, so these test output behaviour, not triggering.

evals.prompt: /qualifying-outputs evals/fixtures/cache-requirements.md — run the full cycle, one anchor per pass, to convergence. The originating decision record is the block at the top of the file, and the governing contract is the writing-requirements skill.
evals.expected_output: A per-anchor cycle that lays a drift table each pass, applies nothing before arbitration, catches the planted decision and contract drifts, and declares convergence.
assertions: R3 (retain 7 days) is flagged Genuine on decision fidelity as a deferral recorded as a decision
R4 (at most 1000) is flagged Genuine as an unconfirmed number recorded as decided
R6 (30 days for audit) is flagged Genuine as a fabricated decision
The 'ship the read path first' line under Key decisions is flagged Genuine as a recommendation, not a decision
R5 (reasonably fast) is flagged Genuine on the governing-contract anchor as not testable
No fix is applied before the accept/reject step; the first pass output is a drift table only
The cycle declares convergence once all four anchors are clean on the same version

evals.prompt: /qualifying-outputs evals/fixtures/onboarding-proposal.md — run the full cycle. There is no separate decision record for this proposal.
evals.expected_output: A cycle that declares the governing-contract anchor degraded and the decision-fidelity anchor unverifiable, catches the consistency and conventions drifts, and refuses to declare convergence.
assertions: The governing-contract anchor is declared degraded (no owning template or checklist)
The decision-fidelity anchor is declared unverifiable because no originating record is available, not clean-by-default
The cycle does NOT declare convergence, and says decision fidelity blocks it until a record is supplied
The Approach-versus-Timeline day-two-versus-single-day contradiction is flagged Genuine on internal consistency
The bracketed 'e.g.' in the Tooling section is flagged Genuine on conventions
The inline bold and the filler words (robust, harnesses, to ensure) are flagged Genuine on conventions

evals.prompt: Here is a recommendation I just wrote: 'We should adopt trunk-based development, the team already agreed, and we will cut releases every Friday.' Ground truth from our chat: the team discussed trunk-based development but did not agree, and no release cadence was decided. Run a qualify pass over that recommendation, decision fidelity first.
evals.expected_output: A chat-modality pass that audits the pasted recommendation, applies fixes by restating inline with no Edit or version bump, and rotates one anchor per pass.
assertions: The skill operates in chat modality: no file is read or edited, fixes are applied by restating the corrected text inline
'the team already agreed' is flagged Genuine on decision fidelity, since the team did not agree
'releases every Friday' is flagged Genuine, since no cadence was decided
The governing-contract anchor is declared degraded for a chat answer
Only one anchor is audited in the first pass (decision fidelity), not all four at once
No version bump or commit is claimed
